title: asset-class (M1-002): per-asset processing parameters for the mesh/texture pipeline

class.description: Drives the collision budget defaults (vehicle 400 tris, building 800 tris, others 400 [to be tuned]).

texture_profile.description: Default profile for colour textures: bg = ETC1S (background / large areas); hero and ui = UASTC (characters, weapons, UI); normal = UASTC (also what a normal-map slot always gets). Normal-map slots are always UASTC with a 2-channel RRRG layout whatever the asset profile is.

textures.description: Per-texture profile overrides keyed by the glTF texture name (or image name).

lod_ratios.description: Override of the LOD triangle ratios (ARCHITECTURE 11.1: 1 / 0.5 / 0.25 / 0.1). First entry must be 1, strictly decreasing, at most 8 levels.

max_hulls.description: convex mode: maximum number of convex pieces (default and hard cap 32)

max_hull_vertices.description: convex mode: points kept per hull before hull construction (default 48)

first_person.description: Single-chain asset that is the first-person model of a weapon: the chain gets the `_fp` suffix. Use `variants` for the two independent chains of one weapon.

variants.description: D-FP: two independent LOD chains from one asset (first person 25k-60k tris, third person 5k-12k tris [to be tuned]).
